title.value: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network
title.justification: The title precisely describes the core methodology used in the study, which is the development of a graph neural network framework for optimizing handover parameters in cellular networks.
title.quote: Neighbor Auto-Grouping Graph Neural Networks for Handover Parameter Configuration in Cellular Network

extractions.description: This paper proposes an innovative framework using graph neural networks (GNN) for optimizing handover parameters in cellular networks. The approach focuses on the auto-grouping of neighboring cells to tackle complex dependencies and optimize network performance without a need for extensive manual intervention.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper emphasizes the role of cellular networks in enhancing infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, fostering innovation, enabling sustainable cities, and supporting economic growth, aligning with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Moreover, it can highly contribute to enhancing infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, fostering innovation, responsible consumption, enabling sustainable cities and communities, and promoting decent work and economic growth.

primary_category.justification: The focus on improving network efficiency and reducing the reliance on manual interventions aligns with the broader goals of sustainable urban development and infrastructure, which are interlinked with climate change mitigation strategies.
primary_category.quote: Moreover, it can highly contribute to enhancing infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, fostering innovation, responsible consumption, enabling sustainable cities and communities, and promoting decent work and economic growth.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not specifically address financial aspects directly but implies economic efficiency and reduction in operational costs through automation and network optimization.
secondary_categories.quote: It has the potential to massively reduce costs arising from human expert intervention and maintenance.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper mentions the potential to expand high-quality network access to underserved regions, which aligns with supporting infrastructure development in the Global South.
secondary_categories.quote: It opens up the potential for high-quality internet access to geographical areas that are currently under-served by the cellular network.

primary_sub_category.justification: The relevance to energy efficiency is implicit through improving network operations and reducing infrastructure overhead, leading to more efficient energy use in accommodating growing network demands.
primary_sub_category.quote: Thus, improving the cellular network has both economic and social impact towards achieving United Nations Sustainable Development Goals...Moreover, it can highly contribute to enhancing infrastructure, promoting sustainable industrialization, fostering innovation, responsible consumption, enabling sustainable cities and communities.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The approach indirectly supports renewable energy by optimizing network infrastructures which can better accommodate variable energy sources.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Our approach can massively reduce costs from human expert intervention and maintenance. It opens up the potential for high-quality internet access to geographical areas that are currently under-served by the cellular network.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The automation and optimization strategy presented could be used as a case study or benchmark for policy-making and knowledge dissemination regarding sustainable network infrastructure.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Our proposed model, i.e., TAG-GCN, investigates the impact of the adjacent cells and differentiate their impact on the center cell of each cluster.

applications.value: Optimizing cellular network performance for reduced environmental impact
applications.justification: The application of graph neural networks for optimizing cellular network performance can lead to a more sustainable network infrastructure with reduced energy waste.
applications.quote: In this work, we propose a learning-based framework for handover parameter configuration... Our framework addresses this challenge in two ways.
